note: Two Make.com scenarios total (free-plan limit is 2 active scenarios): (1) FB-POST-OSTAPDOTCENKO — its own webhook, Page fixed to ostapdotcenko, payload {text, image}, no 'project' field needed. (2) FB-POST-AURA-GTT — ONE shared webhook for both Aura and Global Tech Tour, with a Router splitting on the payload's 'project' field ('aura' or 'globaltechtour', lowercase exact match — filters are case-sensitive, this bit us once) into two Facebook Pages 'Create a Post with Photos' branches, each with its Page fixed. All Facebook Pages modules: Photos->URL mapped to {{1.image}}, Post caption mapped to {{1.text}}. No 'link' field anywhere — the article/site URL is folded into the text itself since these are native photo posts, not link-preview cards. content_mode 'mirrors_blog' (ostapdotcenko only): the FB post reuses that project's own blog article title/excerpt/cover image directly — see ostapdotcenko/scripts/post-to-facebook.mjs, run manually after publishing a new RU blog article. content_mode 'original' (aura, globaltechtour): the FB post MUST be original content, meaningfully different from that day's blog article and Telegram posts — drafted as JSON ({text, image}) in claude-control/data/fb-queue/<project>/<name>.json, posted via `node claude-control/scripts/post-to-facebook.mjs <project> <name>.json`, which reads this file for the right webhook_url and folds in the project field automatically, then moves the draft to fb-queue/<project>/sent/.
